exposure: different platelet transfusion threshold guidelines (Epoch I: 30/50 x 10^9/L; Epoch II: 20/50 x 10^9/L; Epoch III: 25/50 x 10^9/L)
outcome: median number of transfusions per neonate
percentage of transfusions given above 25 or 50 x 10^9/L
cohort: Very preterm infants (born <32 weeks' gestation) admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit between 2004 and 2022.
finding: Implementation of more restrictive platelet transfusion guidelines significantly reduced the rate and number of platelet transfusions in very preterm infants without significantly affecting mortality or bleeding rates.
